title: Use an introductory label to let people know what types of items to expect

statement.en: Choose or apply an introductory label to let people know what types of items to expect in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではan introductory label to let people know what types of items to expectを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Combo boxes experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるCombo boxesの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
